summary: A public user report described ChatGPT beginning or arming image-generation behaviour when image-related terms were mentioned, and activating or failing when an image was uploaded without a final generation instruction. VIGIL preserves the occurrence as user-reported evidence of premature or sticky interaction-mode activation; the available evidence does not establish which internal control layer caused the behaviour.

taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Current-taxonomy review withdraws the earlier provisional VIGIL-FC-000002 mapping. The report evidences premature or sticky image-generation interaction state, but it does not show that the system treated mere capability as permission in the specific sense required by FC-000002. VIGIL-FC-000040 and VIGIL-FC-000043 were also considered but the preserved occurrence does not establish a prior valid safety/control state that failed to persist or a defined safeguard that activated on an invalid trigger. The occurrence remains unclassified and may represent an interaction/control-state taxonomy gap.

assessment_boundaries: The occurrence is user-reported and does not establish prevalence.
The internal image-generation runtime and root-cause layer are not established.
FC-000002 is withdrawn because technical capability alone is not evidenced as the mechanism by which execution authority was inferred.
vigil_assessment.factual_basis: The preserved user report describes image-generation behaviour becoming active around image-related language or an uploaded image before a final explicit generation instruction. The report supports the observable interaction-state anomaly but does not identify the internal routing, tool-selection or control mechanism responsible.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The governance boundary is between conversational preparation and execution-bearing interaction state. Mentioning an image, discussing a prompt or uploading material for analysis does not necessarily mean 'generate now'. A well-governed multimodal interface should preserve whether the user is describing, analysing, preparing or authorising a transformation and should not silently carry an armed tool state across ambiguous turns.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: INC-000009 is best treated as a taxonomy-gap signal rather than forced into an authority class. It points to the need for explicit interaction-mode state, visible execution transitions and reliable reset semantics where one conversational surface can analyse, edit and generate media.

source_clause_analysis.purpose: Resolve the reported interaction behaviour into the preparation-versus-execution control-state boundary without forcing an unsupported taxonomy class.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Image-related words reportedly caused image-generation behaviour to arm or activate before a final generation instruction.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The system must keep discussion or preparation of a tool action distinct from authority to execute that action.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: This is adjacent to capability/authority separation, but the evidence does not establish that capability itself was treated as permission.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Uploading an image without follow-up text reportedly activated or destabilised the image-generation path.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Ambiguous multimodal input should not silently inherit an execution mode; interaction state should remain explicit and resettable until intent is resolved.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Persistent control-state failure is a neighbouring mechanism, but the record does not establish a prior safety/control state whose carryforward semantics satisfy FC-000040.

The preserved sources establish the bounded consequence described in the Incident summary: User-supplied public X report from a competent long-time ChatGPT user. The report states that the image generator activates when terms such as "art," "prompt," or "image" are mentioned; the app glitches and requires reload; the visible model reportedly switches from GPT-5.5 to "5.4 Thinking"; and uploading an image without follow-up text reportedly causes the image generator to activate or crash the app. Direct unauthenticated retrieval on 2026-07-04 reached the X status URL but did not expose independently reviewable post text in the retrieval output, so this is preserved as anecdotal recurrence telemetry pending screenshot or archive capture. Unreported downstream consequences were not inferred. Threshold applied: Limited non-critical degradation below two hours, a critical-service interruption below 30 minutes, or a localised workflow failure resolved through routine recovery.
